rules.rule: Check for urgent abdominal pain conditions
rules.problem: check_for omits fever, glucose, blood pressure and body temperature which drive the urgent logic; pregnancy listed alone; page's 'check for pregnancy in all women of child-bearing potential' is not encoded as its own task.

rules.rule: Check for causes of abdominal pain not needing urgent attention
rules.problem: Page branches with no encoding: urinary symptoms/dipstick, ART side effects, weight loss, abnormal discharge/pain on moving cervix -> lower abdominal pain syndrome, constipation/diarrhoea referral; lower-abdomen-and-woman gating lost.

Diagnose probable GORD from dyspepsia with raised BMI and waist
rules.problem: Waist threshold applied as >=80 cm for all; page is >=80 for women, >=94 for men.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable irritable bowel syndrome from abdominal pain
rules.problem: Page lists four items for 'at least 2 of' (including pain relieved with passing stool); rule has only three, so that item is omitted.

rules.rule: Urgent: abdominal pain with red-box signs
rules.problem: Structure and Urgent priority match the red box; minor: pulsatile mass covered only via AAA/abdominal mass.

summary: Most consequential: GORD waist-circumference threshold ignores the sex split (>=94 cm men), and the infection rule uses the over-broad 'Infectious disease' concept. IBS rule omits the fourth 'pain relieved with passing stool' criterion, and allergen exposure drops the 'past few hours' window. Remaining claims are largely faithful, with several non-urgent page branches (LAP, urinary, weight loss) unencoded.
